summary: A ladder from the simplest tool to the most complex: a rule, one model call, RAG, an agent, a person. Five questions decide, and not using AI is a design decision. Real numbers: a dictionary lookup beat a vector search for an error code, and all 20 knowledge base pages are only 862 tokens. You choose an approach for five use cases and defend the boring one.
goal: Choose rules, LLM, RAG or agent for 5 use cases.

items.text: Choose an approach for five use cases using the five questions in order, with one line of why
Defend the rules or person choice against 'but AI can do this', with a number
Run rule_vs_rag.py and count the tokens of your whole knowledge base
Find a use case where the questions give an answer you disagree with, and name the missing question
Play the Rules or AI game to the end and see your score
